cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That strip of tape I added is holding the whole stage curtain up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Untidiness has just saved the finale.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the person you asked to remove the tape.
